wait_for_the_overlay_compatibility_check: Wait for the overlay compatibility check.
could_not_save_this_game_s_settings: Could not save this game's settings.
appearance_for_this_game_only_does_not_c: Appearance for this game only. Does not change the global profile or FPS limits.
the_limit_applies_only_to_this_game_even: The limit applies only to this game, even with the HUD hidden. Leave blank to use the global limit.
uses_mangohud_while_the_overlay_is_loade: Uses MangoHUD while the overlay is loaded, even with both panels hidden.
automatic_uses_mangohud_s_lowest_positiv: Automatic uses MangoHUD’s lowest positive limit (or 30 FPS if none). Restores the configured limit when returning. Each process has its own temporary profile. Experimental: requires compatible focus detection and Vulkan. Saves automatically; relaunch the game to apply.
compare_two_mangohud_recordings_to_evalu: Compare two MangoHUD recordings to evaluate this game's FPS and smoothness. Check the effect of changes to Proton, graphics or performance settings.
record_the_same_scene_under_both_conditi: Record the same scene under both conditions for a consistent comparison.
in_game_mako_and_unfocused_fps_controls_: In-game MAKO and unfocused FPS controls. Starts hidden; open with the shortcut below.
experimental_requires_64_bit_vulkan_nati: Experimental: requires 64-bit Vulkan. Native Linux input requires Wayland. 32-bit Windows games may need WoW64 in Advanced; disable it if it fails. 32-bit Linux is unsupported.
on_flatpak_steam_the_overlay_is_prepared: On Flatpak Steam, the overlay is prepared inside the sandbox.
with_frame_generation_mangohud_measures_: With frame generation, MangoHUD measures and limits total FPS, including generated frames.
